name: VGGFace2
description: In this paper, we introduce a new large-scale face dataset named VGGFace2. The dataset contains 3.31 million images of 9131 subjects, with an average of 362.6 images for each subject. Images are downloaded from Google Image Search and have large variations in pose, age, illumination, ethnicity and profession (e.g. actors, athletes, politicians). The dataset was collected with three goals in mind: (i) to have both a large number of identities and also a large number of images for each identity; (ii) to cover a large range of pose, age and ethnicity; and (iii) to minimize the label noise. We describe how the dataset was collected, in particular the automated and manual filtering stages to ensure a high accuracy for the images of each identity. reputation: VGGFace2 is a widely used large-scale face recognition dataset and a standard pretraining/evaluation resource in face recognition research.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; performance is often near-saturated on easier splits, and results can be sensitive to identity overlap and dataset curation.
